title: B.C. Coroners Service to hold inquest into police-involved death
article: The B.C. Coroners Service is holding an inquest into the death of a man who lost consciousness in the back of an Abbotsford police cruiser.
Christopher Leslie Kampman, 37, went into medical distress after being arrested for trespassing on July 1, 2011.
Kampman was taken to Abbotsford Regional Hospital where he was pronounced dead.
The inquest is scheduled to begin on April 15, 2013, at the B.C. Coroners Service courtroom in Burnaby.
